paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop frequency. The x-axis represents s_pop frequency in units of 10^4, with values ranging from 2 x 10^4 to 19 x 10^4, marked at intervals of 2 x 10^4, and labeled with numeric tick labels at regular intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, marked at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines: a blue dashed line with circle markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line starts at approximately 0.9 and remains relatively stable around 0.95-1.0 across the x-axis range, with a slight dip at 14 x 10^4. The green line starts at around 0.4, fluctuates with a peak at 7 x 10^4 (approximately 0.7) and another peak at 17 x 10^4 (approximately 1.0), and ends at 1.0. Both lines have vertical error bars indicating variability in the data.
